title: (Pwn2Own) Lexmark CX331adwe concatstrings Type Confusion Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Lexmark CX331adwe printers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the concatstrings method. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a type confusion condition. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of the device.
